areas.title: Hatha
areas.existing_architecture: Existing full-pose → metric bridge → ROM/assessment battery. Calibrate visibility, camera-plane and measurement repeatability against human annotations. Five yoga courses are not wired to a yoga-pose classifier; adding course pose/transition assessment needs a separate task/metric/runtime design proposal.
areas.next_operation: Human teaching demonstration and annotation → exact pinned extraction/DSP replay → reference/rule calibration candidate → heldout evaluation → real-device parity. No runtime promotion in this change.
areas.acceptance_gap: Physical teaching/rights/learner and device evidence open; no first-party capture supplied. Yoga course scoring/runtime binding absent; ROM battery is a different task.
